title: FREE Halo Pelican, and paid Harrier II & Hindenburg! | MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update
description:
Are you looking to expand your virtual hangar in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 this week, or are you deciding which new Marketplace add-ons are actually worth your hard-earned cash? Today's marketplace drop bounces across eras, altitudes, and universes—from VTOL combat jets and a limited-time FREE Halo dropship to regional twin-prop commuters and a massive historic Zeppelin! Whether you want to grab the D77-TC Pelican before the free window closes or test your touchdowns with Landing Rate Pro, this update has plenty to explore.

In this marketplace breakdown, we take a close look at features, cockpit systems, realistic expectations, and new releases across the MSFS 2024 virtual flight line:

🛩️ MILITARY & SCI-FI CRAFT
We kick things off with vertical lift and tactical firepower before jumping into the Halo universe:
• DC Designs AV-8B Harrier II: Now available in MSFS 2024, bringing the legendary Pegasus-powered VTOL fighter with 12 liveries (RAF, Spanish Armada, Italian Air Force) and a minimal paint kit.
• RP Simulations EMB-314 / A-29 Super Tucano: A native MSFS 2024 edition of the versatile turboprop light-attack and training aircraft, featuring custom MFDs, HUD, EFB integration, and external fuel systems.
• Halo D77-TC Pelican: Available for FREE for a limited time (make sure to claim it before November 17th!). We look at what is included in this MSFS 2024 aircraft-only release, including custom avionics, full interior, and 12 liveries.

🚢 COMMERCIAL COMMUTERS & HISTORIC AIRSHIPS
Looking for multi-role regional flying or a trip back to the golden age of airships?
• FlightSim Studio AG Tecnam P2012 Traveller V2: Completely rebuilt natively for MSFS 2024 with a rent-to-buy option, 7 selectable cabin configurations (including VIP, cargo, medevac, and skydive), customized G1000 NXi avionics, and full Career Mode compatibility.
• Redwing Simulations LZ 129 Hindenburg: The largest commercial airship ever built, recreated with a 4K 3D cockpit, nav/engineer/radio rooms, 50 voiced AI crew members, 50 animated passengers, and 7 liveries. We also flag its hefty hardware requirements before you buy.

🛠️ UTILITIES, AUDIO & LIVERY PACKS
Round out your sim setup with new immersion tools, liveries, and free hardware support:
• Landing Rate Pro (EK Interactive): Cross-platform touchdown scoring (PC, Xbox, and VR) tracking vertical speed, G-force, bank, bounces, and runway conditions with a 1-to-5 "Dangerous to Butter" rating.
• Bravo Airspace & Supersonic A330 Audio Suite (Asian Crew): True 3D positional audio overhaul and bilingual Mandarin cabin announcements for the iniBuilds Airbus A330.
• HR SimYard H125 US Law Enforcement Livery Pack 3: Five authentic US police and sheriff schemes for the H125, including Ontario PD, Ohio State Highway Patrol, Miami-Dade PD, Texas DPS, and San Bernardino County Sheriff.
• Honeycomb Aeronautical Echo Aviation Controller: A FREE preconfigured controller profile package so you can plug in and fly immediately in MSFS 2024.

Which of these new add-ons are you loading onto the ramp first? Hovering the AV-8B Harrier II, claiming the free Halo Pelican, or taking the LZ 129 Hindenburg out for a cruise? Let us know in the comments below!

If you find these marketplace breakdowns helpful, don't forget to hit that like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and clear skies on your next flight!
